environment: maven:3.9.6-eclipse-temurin-21; test harness only; pinned production sources unchanged
scope: 24 production primitive outcomes (ordinary retrieval, Force loss, UseForce and Secret Plans) and six actual Off The Edge outcomes with a controlled fractional target DestinyModifier. Native tests retain exact reference observations and separately assert nearest-whole official-rule outcomes, rather than labeling discrepancies as conformance.

adjudication.rule: Round indivisible card movements to nearest whole number after applicable modifiers; preserve raw destiny comparisons. Half values round up.
adjudication.gemp: All 30 executed reference cases round positive fractional movement obligations up.
adjudication.native: For the tested inputs, 14 match the whole-card outcome and 16 differ because the fractional part is below 0.5. The native engine follows AR p30 plus the explicit p139 Brainiac example.
adjudication.timing: Retrieval is rounded once after initiation responses/modifiers, before first-card selection and Secret Plans. Non-battle loss rounds the full modified obligation, then subtracts integer cards already paid. Payment converts each payer cost before affordability and serialized unit payment.
adjudication.interpretation: Applying the Brainiac indivisibility instruction to all fractional Force payments and retrieval forms is the general rounding interpretation, not an additional card-specific official ruling.

limitations: Fractional battle damage residuals payable through a mixture of forfeiture and Life Force need separate timing verification; battle and attrition numeric values are not globally rounded.
Compound-card counting, fractional activation quantities, broader prevention/replacement and any up-to range without a legal positive integer remain unfinished.
No new granting cards, complete catalog, full deck admission or vehicle/space behavior are certified. Full native admission remains closed.
